from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u024/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Complete each three-of-four mirrored motif in the tiled grid."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0]
    row_starts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in sep_rows]
    row_ends = sep_rows + [h]
    col_starts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in sep_cols]
    col_ends = sep_cols + [w]
    nr, nc = len(row_starts), len(col_starts)
    panels = [[None for _ in range(nc)] for _ in range(nr)]
    for pr, (r0, r1) in enumerate(zip(row_starts, row_ends)):
        for pc, (c0, c1) in enumerate(zip(col_starts, col_ends)):
            cells = [(r-r0, c-c0, grid[r][c])
                     for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] != 0]
            if cells:
                colors = {v for _, _, v in cells}
                if len(colors) == 1:
                    panels[pr][pc] = (next(iter(colors)), {(r, c) for r, c, _ in cells})
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    additions = []
    for r in range(nr - 1):
        for c in range(nc - 1):
            block = [(r, c), (r, c+1), (r+1, c), (r+1, c+1)]
            occupied = [p for p in block if panels[p[0]][p[1]] is not None]
            if len(occupied) != 3:
                continue
            colors = {panels[i][j][0] for i, j in occupied}
            if len(colors) != 1:
                continue
            missing = next(p for p in block if panels[p[0]][p[1]] is None)
            mr, mc = missing
            peer = (mr, mc-1) if mc == c+1 else (mr, mc+1)
            color, shape = panels[peer[0]][peer[1]]
            peer_w = col_ends[peer[1]] - col_starts[peer[1]]
            # Reflect the peer panel left-to-right into the missing panel.
            missing_w = col_ends[mc] - col_starts[mc]
            for rr, cc in shape:
                dest_c = missing_w - 1 - cc
                if 0 <= rr < row_ends[mr] - row_starts[mr] and 0 <= dest_c < missing_w:
                    additions.append((row_starts[mr] + rr, col_starts[mc] + dest_c, color))
            panels[mr][mc] = (color, {(rr, missing_w - 1 - cc) for rr, cc in shape if cc < missing_w})
    for r, c, color in additions:
        out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-85c93e5b.py'
path.write_text(source)
print(path, path.exists())
